title: Tech Note: Connecting WebSTAR and 4D Business Kit using Rewrite

historical_commentary.text: Both WebSTAR and 4D Business Kit have been discontinued for many years, making the specific Rewrite configuration described here obsolete; the general technique of using URL rewriting to connect a web server to an underlying application remains a standard, still-relevant web architecture pattern (now typically done with Apache/nginx rewrite rules or 4D's own built-in web server routing).
related_updates: WebSTAR and 4D Business Kit have both been discontinued for many years
4D's own built-in web server now provides routing/URL-handling capabilities directly, without needing a separate WebSTAR server
